title: Detroit-area postpartum guide: research source and topic catalog
scope: Research catalog for a standalone consumer postpartum companion; guide content requires clinical review. Product and design requirements are recorded in the companion briefs.
notes: Gemma routes guide questions to reviewed pages. Optional personal-document explanation, question preparation and note organization are separate constrained tasks; no independent medical instructions.
Examples are navigation test inputs, not proof of a diagnosis; urgent routing overrides routine topic matches.
Hospital-specific procedures require facility confirmation; no universal magnesium-related fasting rule or hourly BP schedule was established.
Indexed or migrated resources are marked and must be resolved before patient use.

sources.title: Postpartum Care for You and Your Baby
sources.coverage: Rooming-in, identification, newborn checks, discharge and documentation.
sources.limitations: Confirm applicability to Hutzel or Sinai-Grace; corporate education is not a unit protocol.

sources.title: Newborn Care
sources.coverage: In-hospital feeding help and newborn-care teaching.
sources.limitations: Published follow-up timings should not override individualized discharge instructions.

sources.title: Your Postpartum Recovery Plan
sources.coverage: Recovery supplies, practical support, physical and emotional recovery.
sources.limitations: Educational article, not hospital procedure.

sources.title: Postpartum Care for Mother and Newborn after Delivery
sources.coverage: Recovery topics: uterus, bleeding, perineum, bowel function and mood.
sources.limitations: Editorial review required: includes generalized weight-loss targets, tight-bra and blow-dryer advice; do not reproduce those.

sources.title: How Preeclampsia Can Affect You After Your Pregnancy
sources.coverage: Postpartum risks, monitoring, medication adjustment, long-term follow-up.
sources.limitations: Does not establish diet restrictions or inpatient BP-check frequency.

sources.title: Heart Healthy Moms
sources.coverage: Remote BP monitoring, virtual visits and yearlong care after hypertensive pregnancy.
sources.limitations: Eligibility and service access require confirmation; not an emergency monitoring promise by this guide.

sources.title: What to Expect From Heart Healthy Moms
sources.coverage: Program-specific patient expectations.
sources.limitations: Recheck full details before turning into patient instructions.

sources.title: Mental Health During and After Pregnancy
sources.coverage: Perinatal behavioral-health services and care connections.
sources.limitations: Program-specific eligibility; not a crisis service.

sources.title: A Sleep Survival Guide For Exhausted New Parents
sources.coverage: Shared rest planning and emotional health of birth and non-birth parents.
sources.limitations: Pair all sleep suggestions with current infant safe-sleep guidance.

sources.title: Lactation Consultants

sources.limitations: Access varies by location; no guarantee of immediate consultation.

sources.coverage: Latch concerns, nipple pain, mastitis, pumping and avoiding deep breast massage.
sources.limitations: Do not infer infection or recommend antibiotics from symptoms alone.

sources.title: How To Manage Gestational Diabetes
sources.coverage: Follow-up glucose testing and newborn blood-sugar concerns.
sources.limitations: Do not copy 'delivery curative' as a universal promise; postpartum testing remains important.

sources.title: Women-Inspired Neighborhood Network: Detroit
sources.coverage: Community health workers, family support and resources through the first year.
sources.limitations: Verify enrollment, availability and catchment before listing a direct referral.

sources.limitations: General DVT resource, not postpartum-specific prescribing guidance.

sources.title: Cardio-Obstetrics

sources.limitations: Does not give a fixed postpartum inpatient treatment sequence.

sources.title: Cardiomyopathy Clinic

sources.title: You and Your Baby

sources.title: Potential Postpartum Complications

sources.title: Preeclampsia

sources.limitations: Broad condition education; no verified food restriction or hourly BP protocol.

sources.title: Medical Labor and Delivery Intervention

sources.title: Issues Not Producing Breast Milk

sources.limitations: Avoid fixed milk-arrival promises or assuming insufficient intake without assessment.

sources.title: C-Section Delivery Surgery

sources.limitations: Program-specific, not a universal BP schedule or emergency threshold. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 stated.

sources.title: Healthy Healing After Delivery Program
sources.coverage: Severe tears, bladder/bowel symptoms, pelvic-floor assessment and treatment.
sources.limitations: Program says available regardless of delivery hospital; verify current scheduling and coverage.

sources.title: Healing After Birth: Taking Care of Your Wound
sources.coverage: Vaginal wound and C-section wound care topics.
sources.limitations: Old PDF redirects to new library; replace with a working document-specific link before use.

sources.title: Navigating the Transition from Pregnancy to Parenthood
sources.coverage: Tailored postpartum follow-up and high-BP monitoring eligibility.
sources.limitations: Old PDF redirects; retrieve current library record before publishing.

sources.title: Epidural Blood Patch
sources.coverage: CSF-leak headache and purpose of blood patch.
sources.limitations: General procedural handout; postpartum headache needs assessment, not self-diagnosis. Resolve current URL.

sources.title: Postpartum Urinary Retention
sources.coverage: Symptoms and treatment-topic lead for bladder-emptying difficulty.
sources.limitations: Only indexed excerpt reviewed; obtain full current handout before writing catheter instructions.

sources.title: Healing After a Pregnancy: When to Call Your Provider
sources.coverage: Recovery concern categories.
sources.limitations: Conflicts with CDC: higher fever threshold and longer bleeding wait. Not suitable as shared urgency rules.

sources.title: What Is Placenta Accreta? An Expert Explains
sources.coverage: Specialist planning, hemorrhage preparation and condition-specific recovery.
sources.limitations: Not a general pathway for all C-sections or all postpartum bleeding.

sources.title: Urgent Maternal Warning Signs and Symptoms
sources.coverage: Shared maternal warning-sign reference for pregnancy and year after delivery.
sources.limitations: Not a diagnosis tool; hospital-specific escalation wording needs clinical review.

sources.title: Optimizing Postpartum Care
sources.coverage: Ongoing postpartum care and comprehensive recovery domains.
sources.limitations: General timing is not sufficient for high-risk patients; verify current guideline at implementation.

sources.title: 3 Conditions to Watch for After Childbirth
sources.coverage: Preeclampsia, hemorrhage and endometritis with treatment categories.
sources.limitations: Useful where local public treatment descriptions are incomplete.

sources.title: Safe Medication Administration: Magnesium Sulfate
sources.coverage: Infusion monitoring domains and facility policy variation.
sources.limitations: Clinician-facing; summarize rationale only, not dosing or a patient treatment protocol.

sources.title: Postpartum Preeclampsia: Diagnosis and Treatment
sources.coverage: Blood/urine tests, BP medicines and seizure prevention with magnesium.
sources.limitations: Not a Detroit-specific protocol; durations are typical, not guaranteed.

sources.title: Helping Babies Sleep Safely
sources.coverage: Back sleeping, firm flat surface and safe sleep environment.
sources.limitations: Pair parent-rest guidance with this source; no adult-bed or sofa sleep implication.

sources.title: Fever and Your Baby
sources.coverage: Urgent clinician contact for fever in young infants.
sources.limitations: Keep baby warning signs separate from maternal symptoms.

sources.publisher: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services
sources.title: Urgent Maternal Warning Signs
sources.coverage: Michigan warning-sign resource.
sources.limitations: Use CDC's exact temperature boundary for the shared draft.

sources.title: Postpartum Depression
sources.coverage: Depression symptoms, treatment and distinction from transient blues.
sources.limitations: Do not require waiting two weeks when symptoms are severe or safety concerns exist.

sources.title: Maternal Infant Health Program: About Us
sources.coverage: Nurse and social-worker support and connection to community care.
sources.limitations: Confirm current eligibility and local provider access before publishing enrollment details.
